scope: Unchanged Windows SDK frame/focus GUI translated to Wasm inside the browser with actual Wine base DLLs. Seven stages in EXE/ZIP/catalog modes check 86400 surface pixels per stage against actual desktop Wine: solid/hatch/copied pattern frames, XOR focus/double erase, clipped outlines and preserved DC state. Universal DLL support remains incomplete.
oracleReference: Wine 11.0 desktop x86 GDI, macOS; original native SDK DrawFocusRect/FrameRect/GetPixel oracle
provenance: Visible Chromium from final source; HEADED=1 changes only Playwright browser visibility, static /winebrowser/ build without isolation headers.
